description: Verify that perfect-api prod PR remains open despite passing quality gates (autoMerge: false requires manual approval)
method: Check perfect-api-gitops PR #11 state and commit status
expected: PR is OPEN, commit status is success, but PR is NOT merged (autoMerge: false means manual merge required)
actual: PR #11 is open, mergeable=true, merged=false. Commit status shows prod-gate=success with description "All checks passed, safe to promote to prod". Manual approval workflow confirmed.

statuses.description: All checks passed, safe to promote to prod

evidence.explanation: autoMerge: false in the PromotionStrategy means the Promoter sets the commit status but does not auto-merge. A human must review and merge the PR to promote to prod.
